description: This file defines the ReferenceHelper class for handling cell, range, and worksheet reference manipulations within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It includes methods for updating cell references during insertions/deletions, formula reference updates, and managing worksheet components like styles and merged cells.

classes.name: ReferenceHelper
classes.description: A utility class for managing and updating cell, range, and worksheet references during modifications such as row/column insertions or deletions within PhpSpreadsheet.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of the ReferenceHelper class, ensuring a single shared instance.

methods.name: updateFormulaReferences
methods.description: Updates cell references within a formula string, adjusting them for structural changes like inserted or deleted rows and columns.

methods.name: updateCellReferencesAnyWorksheet
methods.description: Updates all cell references in a formula string without regard to worksheet boundaries, applicable for cross-worksheet references.

methods.name: updateNamedFormulae
methods.description: Replaces old worksheet or named range references within formulas with new ones after structural changes.

methods.name: updateNamedRange
methods.description: Updates a specific named range's reference after rows/columns are inserted or deleted.

methods.name: updateCellRange
methods.description: Adjusts cell range references (e.g., 'A1:B2') to account for insertions or deletions in the worksheet.

methods.name: insertNewBefore
methods.description: Inserts or deletes rows/columns before a specified cell address, updating all related references, styles, comments, and formatting accordingly.

methods.name: updateCellReference
methods.description: Updates a single cell or range reference, considering worksheet scope and whether the reference is a range or a single cell.

methods.name: updateFormulaReferencesAnyWorksheet
methods.description: Updates all references within a formula string across worksheets based on structural modifications.
